281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool having a circular shape and including a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are in registration with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __wherein the medial section includes fiber reinforced plastic__.

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises [[a metal]] __a metal honeycomb structure and fiber reinforced plastic__.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a composite material __including fiber reinforced plastic__.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, __wherein the weld ring is bonded to the first and second layers__.

286. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

287. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is [[continuous]] __segmented__.

289. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 288, wherein the weld ring is segmented.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, __and wherein the inner ring is bonded to the first and second layers__.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes [[central opening]] __a central opening__.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, __wherein the weld ring is bonded to the first and second layers__.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is [[continuous]] __segmented__.

295. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 294, wherein the weld ring is segmented.
